text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-queue (high queue depth) — alert_id=PD-8732

pagerduty-bot: page fired to schedule=eng-oncall, escalation_policy=primary_oncall, urgency=high

maya: ack'd — I'm the current oncall, jumping in. seeing 65k queued requests across hv-*/inference-frontend. autoscaler metrics show desired_replicas not increasing for ~7m. :thinking_face:

jordan: thanks maya — I'm looking at the scale-controller logs and kube events now. any customer impact reported?

maya: not yet reported publicly but token queue delay > 2s for many requests, some timeouts at 504. internal SLOs trending down. starting mitigation.

samir: quick note — autoscaler heartbeat metrics show controller.last_seen=1768314040 (old). kube HPA target CPU looks fine; this feels like controller-side throttling or apiserver rate limiting.

leo: on logs: getting repeated errors from scale-controller: `failed to submit scale request: rpc timeout` followed by `rate limit exceeded` spikes. suspect provider API quota hitting.

maya: immediate mitigations: 1) disable aggressive scaling gate -> set `controller.scale_gate=false` for service inference-frontend 2) open manual node-provision path 3) increase worker pool max temporarily

jordan: doing 1 now — patched config via `kubectl -n prod patch deploy scale-controller --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"controller","env":[{"name":"SCALE_GATE","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'`

samir: creating manual node request to cloud provider. command:
```
cloudctl compute servers create --pool inference-workers --count 8 --instance-type g5.xlarge --tags=automanual-scale
```

leo: provisioning kicked off, provider responding slowly. estimated 7-9m to become ready.

dina: copying customer-impact checklist: pls confirm which tenants routed to this cell — we need to notify PM + cs if any enterprise tenants are affected.

maya: checked routing map — cell=us-west-2a-hostpool-7 handles prod traffic for startup-ryo and midmarket-fin. ryo has PLG traffic, fin has SLA. tagging @pm-fin and @cs-ryo if we end up needing an incident notification.

pagerduty-bot: page acknowledged by maya. escalation: no auto-escalation pending for 10m.

maya: rolling canary fallback: switching requests to fallback-model-compact for non-SLAs to reduce token processing. patching route: `redwood route set inference-frontend --fallback-model fallback-compact --selector non_sla=true`

jordan: fallback enabled for non_sla — saw a 30% drop in per-token compute, queue depth trending down from 65k -> 42k in 3m. good signal.

samir: manual quota request approved: bumped provider API QPS to 2x for scale-controller service account. that might reduce RPC timeouts.

leo: node provisioning succeeded for 6/8 nodes at 1768314780, remaining 2 still creating. pods are scheduling to new nodes.

maya: queue depth now 12k, average latency down to 620ms. still above SLO but improving. continuing monitoring and will not close until <2k backlog sustained for 10m.

dina: CX note prepared: "We observed transient capacity exhaustion in US-West cell causing increased latency and some 504s. Immediate mitigations applied (manual scale + fallback routing). No confirmed data loss. Working on root cause and long-term mitigation plan." Keep me posted if we need to escalate. :memo:

jordan: ops followups: capture controller pod logs and span traces around 1768313900-1768314200 and upload to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1768314560/trace.log

samir: grabbing logs now. relevant grep: `grep -E "rpc timeout|rate limit" controller.log | sed -n '1,200p'` produced repeated `rate limit exceeded` at 1768314023-1768314148.

maya: handing off to next oncall in 25m — @jordan will be primary during long tail. I'll create a short incident note and flag for SRE postmortem.

jordan: acknowledged handoff. will monitor for 60m and coordinate post-incident followup.

incident-bot: incident thread tagged severity=sev2, created incident=INC-2026-0315-72, channel=incidents, runbook=autoscaler-queue-delta

maya: final status update for now: mitigations applied, queue draining, no enterprise outage confirmed, CS/PM notified for potential SLA impact. I'll reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:

jordan: capturing action items: 1) increase provider quota grace limits 2) add backoff & retry for scale-controller RPCs 3) add metric alert for controller.last_seen < 2m 4) write runbook step for manual fallback routing. I'll put these in INC-2026-0315-72.

leo: marking logs saved to s3, Correlation ID=inc-1768314560.

samir: postmortem request queued. assigning <samir> as lead.

dina: noted — will prepare CS communications draft once severity confirmed.

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged and escalations paused.

jordan: closing thread for now, monitoring-only. ping if regressions. :coffee:
